description: Bitnob enables users across the continent to purchase bitcoin as an asset class, providing an automated way to do this while protecting them from the downside (volatility) and expanding the use case for cryptocurrencies by enabling businesses to receive them as payments.
tagline: Virtual payment platform for Africans

description: Bloc gives businesses the opportunity to easily tap into the gold mine of FinTech solutions, from payment gateways and international payments to global digital banks to decentralised finance. Bloc helps businesses of all sizes build, launch, and grow their FinTech applications in less than half the usual time it takes.
tagline: Easy-to-use banking, payments and operations tools for businesses

description: Brass is a digital bank for small and medium businesses. Brass provides them with a suite of products — credit and payment services, payroll and expense management, API, cash-flow analytics, team management, POS, debit and credit cards — all wrapped around a business bank account.
tagline: Commerce and financial tools for African businesses

description: Bridgecard is a card issuing provider for fintechs in Nigeria and Africa at large with easy-to-integrate APIs, allowing them to give virtual and physical Mastercard or VISA cards with a limit of up to $10,000 or €10,000 monthly to their users within five days or less.
tagline: API services for virtual and physical cards issuance

description: Explore, analyse, and visualise your data easily with Caantin AI. Caantin is building advanced models that transform the way the fastest-growing companies understand their data and make decisions.
tagline: Earth's most helpful data analyst

description: Catlog offers merchants on social media a simple way to take orders via chat, manage their businesses & get paid easily. Through a custom store link created for the merchant, potential customers can shop and make payments seamlessly.
tagline: Operations management and payment services for businesses

description: Chargel is more than just a road transport platform; it is a gateway to optimised logistics in French-speaking West African countries. Chargel simplifies and streamlines transportation by helping shippers easily find available trucks to move goods while carriers discover lucrative new business opportunities.
tagline: Simplified first-mile logistics in Francophone West African countries

description: ChowCentral is building an asset-light restaurant chain for Africa. ChowCentral partners with commercial kitchens like hotels and third-party delivery providers to serve customers at 10 times less cost than traditional brick-and-mortar restaurants. Through ChowCentral's food brands, customers get access to a wide variety of meals.
tagline: Delivering tasty meals in minutes

description: CoBuildit is a project management company with a platform that allows users to invest in ongoing building projects and earn attractive returns. Every CoBuildit user can part-fund the construction of new homes, allowing home buyers a more extended timeframe to pay for their homes.
tagline: Enabling group investment in building projects

description: Connected Analytics is a multi-channel platform for businesses to acquire, retain and reward loyal customers at the point of payment for purchases. With an infrastructure for rewards, loyalty, deals, buy now, pay later, and cash back, Connected Analytics has perfected one offering: the cashback product where merchants can get more walk-in customers.
tagline: Providing robust customer management solutions for banks and businesses across Africa

description: Cova allows users to track, manage, and access their assets across multiple platforms through a simple-to-use dashboard. Regardless of domiciled location, users can store relevant documents in a virtual fault and link their bank and pension accounts, crypto wallets, and stock portfolios to their Cova accounts.
tagline: Automated investment portfolio tracking and asset management

description: Credable is driving the future of banking by enabling financial and non-financial institutions to deploy various digital financial solutions, such as digital savings wallets, lending products, payments, and more, to their end consumers, through a modern API-driven platform.
tagline: BaaS solutions for non-financial businesses across emerging markets

description: CreditClan, also known as Clan Africa, helps banks, merchants, and businesses provide credit to consumers across Africa. Clan Africa hopes to get thousands of merchants so that more sectors like the medical, real estate, and insurance will have businesses offering credit and pay-later options to customers.
tagline: Helping businesses & individuals offer split payment to consumers across Africa.

description: CrowdForce crowdsources trusted industry insights, market research for public and private organisations, and financial services to individuals through their agent network. PayForce, a sub-brand of Crowdforce, provides modern banking services for merchants of all sizes.
tagline: Modern banking services for merchants

description: Cybervergent is at the forefront of ensuring digital resilience in Africa by building products that help businesses drive governance, security, privacy, compliance and manage risk across digital ecosystems.
tagline: Building the infrastructure for continuous digital trust

description: Earnipay enables employers to offer employees instant access to daily earned salaries without changing their payment process through an innovative earn-as-you-work solution. Earnipay integrates with companies’ existing payroll systems while employees can then track and withdraw their accrued salaries via the app.
tagline: Enabling employers to offer employees instant access to daily earned salaries

description: eBanqo is an omnichannel customer engagement platform that helps businesses to automate customer support, provide live chat, and offer their services on web chat and messaging apps that customers already use, reducing the support team's workload and enabling customers to enjoy business services from multiple platforms.
tagline: Omnichannel customer engagement platform for businesses

description: Engage provides marketing automation tools for businesses with features that allow business owners to deliver personalized campaigns and automate customer onboarding, conversion and retention messages.
tagline: Marketing automation tools for businesses

description: Fez Delivery is a tech-enabled last-mile logistics service operating across different verticals such as fintech, fashion, electronics, skincare and beauty, pharma, and food delivery. Fez Delivery's offerings include global shipping, local delivery, and corporate delivery management software.
tagline: Optimising logistics for businesses

description: Fluna is a B2B SaaS digital best-in-class treasury management and financing platform that helps high-growth African exporters and importers tap into global markets via proprietary trade data, flexible financing, and international treasury solutions.
tagline: Accelerating growth for African export businesses

description: Frain is passionate about the product delivery value chain. Frain is home to Convoy, a cloud-native webhook service that allows developers to push webhook events to their users in minutes.
tagline: Simplifying product delivery value chain

description: GeroCare is an affordable subscription-based medical service for parents and older people, entitling them to regular doctor home visits. Aside from providing them with holistic health care services, GeroCare takes care of these people by providing support to improve their quality of life.
tagline: Holistic health care services for elderly persons

description: Gradely is Nigeria’s first truly personalised adaptive learning platform that identifies student learning gaps and offers tools and resources to close them. Gradely empowers educators and parents to make a difference in their ward’s learning outcomes and produce more globally competitive learners through artificial intelligence and real-time data.
tagline: Personalised learning at home and in schools
founders: Boye Oshinaga Femi Ibiwoye Seyi Adelaju

description: Heyfood is a food delivery startup providing end-to-end tools and storefronts to connect users with QSRs, Indie restaurants, and cloud kitchens. Launched in 202, Heyfood has been termed the "DoorDash of Africa" as it operates in and expands to Lagos and other megacities across Africa.
tagline: Delivery restaurant meals in minutes

description: HoneyCoin is a decentralised monetisation & peer-to-peer P2P remittance platform for African creators & consumers. HoneyCoin's financial infrastructure allows individuals and creators monetise their audiences and transact P2P using fiat (traditional currencies like KES, UGX, NGN) and crypto (digital currencies like BTC, ETH, LTC) channels.
tagline: Redefining exchange value and peer-to-peer P2P remittance

description: Itana rests on the ambition of building the ideal environment for the tech ecosystem in Africa, where the best talents build together. We envision a connected community with the ideal governance, digital services and physical infrastructure for builders of the continent to thrive.
tagline: Building Africa's first digital free zone for the builders of tomorrow.

description: Juice is a payment network enabling African businesses to make faster, less complex, cheaper, and more reliable cross-border payments with their local currency. Juice also guides inquiry to integration and beyond for businesses, startups and MTOs' use cases.
tagline: Faster and reliable cross-border payments for African businesses

description: Voom simplifies buying and selling used cars. For sellers, register the car, get it inspected, receive offers, finalize the deal, and receive payment. Buyers can browse, check inspection reports, request test drives, pay, and collect their cars. Voom ensures a hassle-free, secure, and guaranteed experience.
tagline: Streamlining the process of buying and selling used cars

description: LemFi provides best-in-class financial services for Africans in the diaspora. Offerings include a multi-currency account for immigrants to hold, send, and receive money across 30 countries.
tagline: One platform for all international payments

description: Lengo’s mission is to enable companies to “stop guessing Africa” by providing consumer goods companies with granular data and insights on the largely unorganized retail sector that accounts for 90% of purchases on the continent.
tagline: Enabling companies to stop guessing Africa

description: Loomo is a simplified investment platform that helps people access curated long-term investment opportunities. Loomo enables their customers spice up their investments with high-growth opportunities.
tagline: An investment platform with curated long-term investment opportunities

description: Maad is modernizing FMCG distribution by allowing informal retailers to order products from their platform with reliable delivery and low prices and offering working capital credit facilities.
tagline: Modernizing FMCG distribution in Francophone Africa

description: Through MarketForce 360, FMCG companies can manage their field sales activities and grow their distribution channels. MarketForce also enables merchants to earn more by making them a one-stop-shop for digital financial services like buying airtime, paying water bills, and banking & insurance services.
tagline: A unified digital commerce marketplace for African merchants

description: MDaaS (Medical Devices As a Service) provides affordable and high-quality diagnostic infrastructure to underserved Africans. MDaaS has built a network of private diagnostic and primary healthcare centres that offer radiology, cardiology, and lab services.
tagline: Convenient, high-quality, and affordable diagnostics for the continent's next billion

description: Mecho Autotech is a robust and fully interactive technology platform that delivers seamless vehicle maintenance, repair services and aftersales parts. Mecho is able to serve customers and businesses across the automobile value chain due to the extensibility of its offerings.
tagline: Connecting auto business to automotive service providers and quality aftersale parts

description: Migo is a cloud-based platform enabling companies to offer credit to their customers, augmenting traditional bank and payment card infrastructure. Migo's mission is to drive commerce worldwide by injecting liquidity into the last-mile retail sector.
tagline: A lending platform for companies to extend credit to consumers

description: MoneyHash is (MENA) Africa and Middle East's first flexible payments and revenue operations platform covering all payment needs. This platform builds a single API and optimises and scales payment infrastructure at any growth stage. MoneyHash aims to make payments efficient and scalable, empowering businesses to focus on what they do best.
tagline: Hassle-free payments for MENA and Sub-Saharan Africa

description: Moniepoint provides millions of people and businesses across Nigeria with access to banking, payments processing, loans and business management tools.
tagline: Simple solutions to power Nigerian business

description: Mono enables next-generation African businesses to securely access financial data, identity data and bank transfer payments with powerful APIs on one platform. Its plug-and-play technology allows customers to access a broad range of high-quality financial data from African institutions.
tagline: Empowering African businesses with secure financial data access.

description: MyCover.ai is making it easier for people in emerging markets to access insurance products by co-creating insurance products with underwriters and distributing them via integration into existing products and services that people currently use.
tagline: Simplifying and improving insurance access and penetration in emerging markets

description: Myka, a licensed digital insurance broker, is building the distribution infrastructure for retail insurance in Nigeria by connecting insurers to individuals and SMEs through a consumer app, embedded dealer and retailer channels, and a certified partner network, making real insurance as easy to buy as airtime.
tagline: Myka, a licensed digital insurance broker, is building the distribution infrastructure for retail insurance in Nigeria by connecting insurers to individuals and SMEs through a consumer app, embedded dealer and retailer channels, and a certified partner network, making real insurance as easy to buy as airtime.

description: Nomba offers tailored business banking services to SMEs. Their platform facilitates digital payments, provides working capital loans, offers business credit cards, aids in expense management, and provides financial reporting, streamlining SMEs' financial management.
tagline: Tailored banking for SMEs, streamlining financial management.

description: Norebase simplifies business incorporation and registration across African countries. Their platform offers a centralized hub for paperwork and expert guidance, aiding businesses in navigating diverse legal and regulatory landscapes across the continent, with plans for further expansion.
tagline: Simplifying business registration and compliance across Africa

description: Notto is Africa's first licensed alternative credit bureau. Their reliable, secure and accurate rent and bill tracking system uses tenants’ payment data to unlock access to a home loan, at a fair interest rate.
tagline: Unlocking home loans for the informal market through alternative credit-scoring systems

description: Omniretail provides a unified distribution platform, digitizing the chain from distributors to retailers. Omniretail also offers retailers tools for business management including inventory, order tracking, and payment processing.
tagline: Empowering retailers with business tools

description: Payday helps Africans receive and send money globally. They enable customers to open USD, GBP, EUR and 20+ other global accounts for free & spend with the Payday Mastercard.
tagline: Global money transfers and multi-currency spending

description: Paystack is the leading financial technology company in Nigeria and the largest independent neobank worldwide, with more than 20 million clients. Initially a no-fee credit card managed by a mobile app, Nubank has since expanded to include a proprietary loyalty rewards program, digital account and personal loans.
tagline: Modern online and offline payments for Africa

description: Piggyvest, a dynamic fintech platform, empowers users to save for targeted goals and offers diverse investment options including fixed deposits, treasury bills, and mutual funds. Piggyvest currently helps over 4 million customers achieve their financial goals.
tagline: Saving and investing made easy.

description: Pivo offers an array of financial services to supply chain SMEs, including digital payments, working capital loans, inventory financing, trade finance, expense management, and financial reporting, facilitating efficient financial management and business operations.
tagline: Empowering supply chain SMEs with unique financial services

description: Plumter is helping to facilitate easy foreign payments and international banking for African businesses. With its robust infrastructure and network, Plumter acts as the bridge connecting these businesses to global payment rails, streamlining cross-border transactions and enabling seamless financial operations.
tagline: Simplifying international payments for African businesses

description: PressOne provides a shared phone number for teams. With PressOne, businesses can invite their teams to make and receive calls with the same phone number. They also enjoy shared call history, shared call credit, and automatic call recording.
tagline: Building the entrepreneurs' mobile network

description: Printivo helps African business print marketing and business materials with ease. Printivo is an online print shop, users log on to Printivo.com, pick a template they like and edit in real-time to taste, they choose their desired quantity then submit it and pay with a credit card.
tagline: Accessible printing for businesses

description: Quabbly, a no-code automation platform, streamlines business operations by automating tasks like email communication, invoice generation, inventory management, appointment scheduling, and financial tracking, enhancing workflow efficiency and productivity.
tagline: Easy business operations via no-code automation

description: Raenest has built a modern financial management tool for African remote workforce talent and global businesses that removes the pain around contracting, invoicing, and payments. With Raenest, companies can effortlessly onboard remote contractors and employees from Africa, coordinate payments in 50+ currencies, sort out compliances, and control team expenses with virtual cards from one single dashboard, in minutes.
tagline: Simplifying financial management for African remote workforce

description: Rank, formerly Moni, provides financial products to mobile money agents and micro and small-scale merchants using a social accountability credit system. Moni leverages social trust and group responsibility to deliver financial services and business loans to enable small business owners to access working capital.
tagline: Providing SMEs credit solutions leveraging social accountability

description: Reliance HMO provides health insurance plans for individuals, families, and businesses. Their comprehensive coverage includes doctor's visits, hospital stays, and prescription drugs, all at low premiums. Enrollment is straightforward, and they offer 24/7 customer support for assistance.
tagline: Your trusted partner for comprehensive health insurance

description: Remedial Health combines the use of pharmaceutical procurement innovations, inventory financing solutions, and pharmacy operations/patient management solutions to improve access to genuine and affordable medicines in Africa.
tagline: Enhancing access to affordable and authentic medicines in Africa

description: Rise is a financial investment company offering dollar-based investment options. They focus on stability and growth, providing choices in stocks, real estate, and fixed income. Rise empowers users to set financial goals and offers an auto-invest feature. Their professional approach includes partnerships and a supportive community.
tagline: Your financial investment partner for stability and growth

description: Rivy, formerly PayHippo, is building the financial infrastructure to make clean energy easy to afford, quick to access, and open to all.
tagline: Flexible financing for solar energy projects for homes and businesses

description: Saltbox offers comprehensive business solutions, including warehousing, order fulfillment, last-mile delivery, and data analytics. They provide businesses with efficient inventory management and data-driven insights to enhance supply chain decisions, simplifying operations and customer service.
tagline: Providing data-driven supply chain solutions.

description: Seamless HR is an easy to use, robust cloud-based HR management software that handles all human resource processes end to end; Recruitment Management, Talent, Payroll and Learning Management. It focuses on helping businesses optimize staff productivity and retention.
tagline: Streamlining HR management

description: Send is a digital freight forwarding and courier service for African businesses. Send help businesses ship container and air cargo to Nigeria; managing the entire process — from users suppliers in China, US, UK, Dubai, and India, to the customs clearance and last-mile delivery to customers.
tagline: Simplifying freight forwarding for African businesses

description: SendMe currently delivers a variety of the best animal protein to over 100 restaurants and hotels, helping them meet their business needs by creating the best meat experience for their customers and increasing their sales and profit margin.
tagline: Delivering top-quality animal protein to restaurants and hotels.

description: Shekel Mobility is a B2B marketplace catering to auto dealerships, offering tools and resources for sustainable growth. Their products include Shekel Credit, Shekel Pay, and Shekel Trade, empowering dealers with financing, financial management, and a global marketplace.
tagline: Empowering auto dealerships with growth tools and resources.

description: Steward supports schools that are enthusiastic about growing and giving quality education to their students by providiing them with a financial services platform that enables them get loans, collect fees and manage finances.
tagline: Enabling education institutions across Africa financially resilient and sustainable

description: Sudo is a modern card issuing infrastructure, that provides APIs that enable card issuers to create customizable cards (Physical and virtual) that leverage just in time funding features, authorizing their end-users transactions in real-time. Integrated with major global and local card networks, modern card issuing allows companies to build payment solutions to their exact specifications and launch them easily at scale.
tagline: Modern card issuing with customizable physical and virtual cards.

description: SunFi connects users seeking solar energy access with tailored payment plans. Users can access solar power solutions, select income-matching plans, monitor usage, and receive expert support through SunFi.
tagline: Tailored solar energy access with flexible payment plans.

description: Talstack is a subscription-based talent management platform that enables companies to identify learning gaps or growth areas and upskill their employees with tools and courses from Africa’s best operators.
tagline: Subscription-based talent management with upskilling tools and courses.

description: Tambua Health delivers a cheaper app-based handheld ultrasound system vital services at a cheaper rate, prioritizing rural and underserved regions.
tagline: Affordable handheld ultrasound for underserved regions.

description: Tanél Health is a modern health insurance company making it easy for employers and individuals to access affordable, convenient health coverage in Francophone Africa.
tagline: Providing affordable, convenient health insurance for businesses and individuals in Francophone Africa.

description: Termii helps businesses across Africa to use messaging channels to engage, verify and authenticate customer transactions. It enables communication across SMS, email, voice, and instant messaging channels.
tagline: Integrating customer connections and verifications seamlessly across all media.

description: ThriveAgric leverages technology to empower smallholder farmers across Africa by linking them to finance, data-driven best practices, and access to local & global markets for their commodities; towards ensuring food security for all.
tagline: Empowering African farmers through technology for food security.

description: Tizeti is leveraging the large wireless capacity available with wi-fi and plummeting cost of solar panels to create a low CAPEX/OPEX network of owned & operated towers to offer disruptive, customer-friendly pricing for unlimited internet.
tagline: Affordable unlimited internet via innovative Wi-Fi technology.

description: Traction offers a suite of business tools, including payment acceptance, loans, and various software like a retail POS system, e-commerce, invoicing, and CRM. They provide terminals for payments, offer bank transfer options and more for business growth and convenience.
tagline: Business tools for payment, loans, savings, and more.

description: Trove is a micro-investing application that allows users to invest in financial securities in Nigeria (Government Bonds, Stocks) and also in international markets (US Exchange Traded Funds & Stocks of US companies) with the tap of a button.
tagline: Micro-investing app for Nigeria and international markets.

description: Union54's API enables businesses to issue debit cards to customers independently of banks. It offers card management, allowing businesses to set limits and block cards, transaction reporting with details on spending and merchant info, and fraud protection to prevent fraudulent transactions.
tagline: Independent debit card issuance and management for businesses.

description: Vendy offers businesses in Africa a versatile payment platform. It enables them to initiate payments offline and through WhatsApp and accept payments through cards, mobile money, and bank transfers. Features include real-time reporting, dispute resolution, and fraud protection.
tagline: Africa's versatile offline and online payment platform.

description: Verto is a complete FX and payment marketplace built for business. VERTO provides liquidity and price discovery tools for international businesses. The marketplace provides easy access to exotic and foreign currencies with seamless international online payment services
tagline: Cross-border payment solution for SMBs, startups and scale-ups.

description: Wealth8 is a technology-driven platform designed to connect people with wealth and investment opportunities, by providing easy access to global investment products, as well as the ability to learn the language of investing
tagline: Offering access to global investments and investment education.

description: Wesabi is a platform where anybody can request for a reliable and well-trained plumber, electrician, AC repair expert, painter, cleaner, washing machine, and refrigerator repair experts; anything that has to do with the home or office repairs with just a few clicks.
tagline: Connecting people with skilled repair professionals
